calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Assessable Income = Gross Annual Income.
2. Expense Deduction: For Section 40(1) & 40(2) salary and freelance income, 50% standard deduction capped at 100,000 THB combined. For Section 40(8) business income, flat 60% standard deduction applies.
3. Personal Exemption: Fixed 60,000 THB for taxpayer.
4. Deductions: Social Security Fund (5% capped at 750 THB/month = max 9,000 THB/year), Life Insurance (up to 100,000 THB), Health Insurance (up to 25,000 THB, combined life + health capped at 100,000 THB), Home Loan Interest (up to 100,000 THB), PVD/RMF/SSF/Thai ESG (subject to individual limits and combined retirement allowance pool cap of 500,000 THB), Parent Allowance (30,000 THB per parent aged >= 60 with income < 30,000 THB), Child Allowance (30,000 THB per child).
5. Net Taxable Income = Gross Income - Expenses - Personal Allowance - Deductions.
6. Progressive Personal Income Tax Brackets (Section 48 of the Thai Revenue Code):
   - 0 - 150,000 THB: Exempt (0%)
   - 150,001 - 300,000 THB: 5%
   - 300,001 - 500,000 THB: 10%
   - 500,001 - 750,000 THB: 15%
   - 750,001 - 1,000,000 THB: 20%
   - 1,000,001 - 2,000,000 THB: 25%
   - 2,000,001 - 5,000,000 THB: 30%
   - Above 5,000,000 THB: 35%
7. Edge Cases: Salaried employees with single employment income file form P.N.D. 91. Taxpayers with other income sources (Section 40(2)-(8)) file form P.N.D. 90. Half-year tax return (P.N.D. 94) is mandatory for taxpayers earning Section 40(5)-(8) income during January-June.

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Statutory Severance Pay Tiers under Section 118 of the Thai Labor Protection Act (พ.ร.บ. คุ้มครองแรงงาน B.E. 2541 and amendments):
   - Tenure 120 days to < 1 year: 30 days of last wage (1 month)
   - Tenure 1 year to < 3 years: 90 days of last wage (3 months)
   - Tenure 3 years to < 6 years: 180 days of last wage (6 months)
   - Tenure 6 years to < 10 years: 240 days of last wage (8 months)
   - Tenure 10 years to < 20 years: 300 days of last wage (10 months)
   - Tenure 20 years or more: 400 days of last wage (13.33 months / 400 days)
2. Payment in Lieu of Advance Notice (ค่าแทนการบอกกล่าวล่วงหน้า / ค่าตกใจ): Daily Rate (Monthly Salary / 30) x 30 to 60 days if employer terminates without giving advance notice before the next salary payment cycle.
3. Unused Annual Leave Payout: Daily Rate x Unused Leave Days.
4. Tax Treatment on Severance Payout:
   - For employees with service tenure >= 5 years: First 300,000 THB of statutory severance pay is completely exempt from personal income tax under Revenue Department rules. The remaining amount qualifies for special separate tax calculation (ภาษีเงินได้แยกคำนวณสำหรับเงินที่จ่ายครั้งเดียวเพราะเหตุออกจากงาน) with dedicated expense deduction allowance of 7,000 THB per year of service + 50% deduction of remaining balance before applying personal tax brackets.
   - For employees with service tenure < 5 years: Full severance amount is added to regular taxable annual income without the 300,000 THB tax exemption.
5. Edge Cases: Severance pay is legally forfeited if employee is terminated for serious misconduct under Section 119 (e.g., intentional criminal act against employer, gross negligence causing severe financial damage, unapproved absence for 3 consecutive working days).

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Assessment Base Amount: Department of Lands official appraisal value is used for Transfer Fee calculation; maximum of Appraisal Value or Actual Selling Price is used for Withholding Tax, Specific Business Tax, and Stamp Duty.
2. Transfer Fee (ค่าธรรมเนียมการโอน): 2% of Appraisal Value (ราคาประเมินกรมที่ดิน).
3. Mortgage Registration Fee (ค่าจดจำนอง): 1% of total mortgage loan amount registered with bank.
4. Withholding Tax (ภาษีเงินได้หัก ณ ที่จ่าย):
   - Juristic/Corporate Seller: Flat 1% of Appraisal Value or Selling Price (whichever is higher).
   - Individual Seller: Appraisal Value minus standard expense deduction based on ownership years (1 yr: 92%, 2 yrs: 84%, 3 yrs: 77%, 4 yrs: 71%, 5 yrs: 65%, 6 yrs: 60%, 7 yrs: 55%, 8+ yrs: 50%). Result divided by ownership years, calculated against progressive personal income tax table (without 150,000 THB exemption), then multiplied back by ownership years.
5. Specific Business Tax vs Stamp Duty (ภาษีธุรกิจเฉพาะ vs อากรแสตมป์):
   - Specific Business Tax (SBT / ภาษีธุรกิจเฉพาะ): 3.3% (3% tax + 0.3% local municipal tax) of Appraisal Value or Selling Price (whichever higher). Triggered if seller held property for less than 5 years AND seller's name was not on the House Registration (ทะเบียนบ้าน) for at least 1 year.
   - Stamp Duty (อากรแสตมป์): 0.5% of Appraisal Value or Selling Price (whichever higher). Applicable ONLY if property transfer is exempt from Specific Business Tax.

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Standard WHT Formula (Revenue Code Section 3 Trez):
   - Base Amount = Amount before VAT (WHT is ALWAYS calculated on pre-VAT amount).
   - WHT Amount = Base Amount x (WHT Rate / 100).
   - VAT Amount (if applicable) = Base Amount x 0.07.
   - Net Payment to Payee = Base Amount + VAT Amount - WHT Amount.
2. Single-Tier Gross-Up Formula (ผู้จ่ายออกภาษีให้ครั้งเดียว):
   - Grossed-Up Tax Base = Base Amount / (1 - (WHT Rate / 100)).
   - WHT Amount = Grossed-Up Tax Base x (WHT Rate / 100).
   - Net Payout to Payee = Base Amount + VAT Amount (Payee receives full agreed fee without deduction).
3. Perpetual Gross-Up Formula (ผู้จ่ายออกภาษีให้ตลอดไป):
   - Tax Base = Base Amount / (1 - (WHT Rate / 100)).
4. Threshold Rule: WHT deduction is required for payments of assessable income >= 1,000 THB per invoice (or under a long-term continuous contract totaling >= 1,000 THB). Forms: P.N.D. 3 for individual payees, P.N.D. 53 for juristic payees.

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Sole Proprietorship Tax (บุคคลธรรมดา - ภ.ง.ด. 90 Section 40(8)):
   - Expense Deduction: Higher of Standard Flat Deduction (60% of Gross Revenue) OR Proven Actual Expenses.
   - Taxable Net Profit = Revenue - Expenses - Personal Exemption (60,000 THB).
   - Tax Rate: Progressive Personal Income Tax brackets (0% up to 150k, 5% up to 300k, 10% up to 500k, 15% up to 750k, 20% up to 1M, 25% up to 2M, 30% up to 5M, 35% above 5M THB).
   - VAT Rule: Revenue > 1,800,000 THB requires mandatory VAT registration.
2. Company Limited Tax (นิติบุคคล SME / บริษัทจำกัด):
   - Eligible SME Definition: Paid-up Capital <= 5,000,000 THB AND Annual Revenue <= 30,000,000 THB.
   - Taxable Profit = Revenue - Verified Expenses - Annual Accounting/Audit Fees.
   - SME Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Progressive Rates:
     * Profit 0 - 300,000 THB: 0% (Exempt)
     * Profit 300,001 - 3,000,000 THB: 15%
     * Profit > 3,000,000 THB: 20%
   - Standard Corporate CIT Rate (Non-SME): 20% flat rate on all profit.
   - Dividend Withholding Tax: 10% WHT when net profit is distributed as dividend to individual shareholders.
   - Total Tax Burden = CIT + Dividend WHT + Annual Accounting/Audit Fees.
3. Break-even Insight: When annual business profit exceeds ~750,000 - 1,000,000 THB, incorporating a Company Limited generally yields lower overall tax liabilities compared to personal income tax.
